goal: A single 3:4 portrait clearly explains the iPhone 16 Pro's screen, SoC, camera, body material, and starting price, resembling an iOS widget filled with information but with restrained text.

header.main_title: iPhone 16 Pro comprehensive analysis: feel, processing power, and imaging understood at once
header.subtitle: Titanium metal · A18 Pro · triple-camera system · iOS 18 synchronized highlights (parameters based on Apple’s public presentation, numbers in the image are design references)

palette.rule: Module_tints rotate, accent only used for large numbers and CTA-level keywords

layout.grid: 1 hero 2x2 top left; one 1x2 + one 1x1 in each of the upper and lower right columns; bottom area filled with two rows

modules.content: Left side titanium metal original color Pro product side view + main camera module close-up; three bold lines: 'Lighter titanium frame' '5x telephoto for everyday use' '4K/120 Dolby Vision'; star rating five stars; small text: recommended capacity starting from 256 GB

Title 'ProMotion and Peak Brightness': Very fine indicative curve representing refresh rate, large numbers 120 Hz and 2000+ nits example annotations (indicative) + small text: Always-on display, text sharpness.
Giant number 'A18 Pro' + small tag '3nm level second generation' + small icons CPU/GPU/NE
Four mini icons + labels: ProRes / USB-C / spatial video / operation button (illustrated)
Horizontal silhouette of three lenses + 0.5× / 1× / 5× small text, using light gray bars to indicate focal lengths, highlighting 5× for everyday portrait use.
Chinese Yuan 'From ¥7,999 (indicative)' + small print: subject to real-time accuracy on the official website + extra discount for trade-in.
List 3 items: Lock screen/control item customization; small icons for continuous interaction with Mac/iPad; endpoint and cloud AI use privacy icons to the end
Small text: Shell film holds value better · Next slide to view accessory list →; Do not include a real URL
